photos.c: Above: Making a name for herself as one of our toughest competitors, Catherine Bryson seems equally at home on road or track.
Above: Catherine Bryson ran fastest stage for the Belles in the National 4-stage Road Relay

Above: Sarah Murphy and Catherine Bryson tackle the SEAA Cross Country Championship at Holkham Hall, Norfolk, like every other race they’ve been in this winter – fighting for positions near the front of the field.
Above: Catherine Bryson front ran an exciting 1500m to win at Wigan. Also pictured is Sarah Murphy who placed 2nd in both 1500m and 3000m B races.

A team of twelve was all it took to keep Belgrave afloat in Division Two of the UKWAL. Here are seven of them: Jacqui Loney, Hannah Douglas, Vikki Goodwin, Hazel Mead, Christine Bertram, Sarah Gailey and Catherine Bryson.

We were unable to field a full women's team in the SEAA Cross Country Championships but Catherine Bryson gave our supporters plenty to cheer about, always involved in the action towards the front of the 8km race and eventually placing 8th.
